response.overview: Some bands possess an energy that truly makes sense only when experienced up close. That’s the idea behind "+um APRESENTA," a project bringing together intimate performances and candid conversations with the people driving the independent music scene.  In this episode, we welcome Chococorn and The Sugarcanes, straight from Santa Bárbara d'Oeste. The band performs "Palavra de Amigo" and "Agito e Propaganda" while sharing insights into their journey, influences, and the inspiration behind the sound they call "emo caipira," all in conversation with Gustavo Sartori (founder of +um HITS) and Lúcio Ribeiro (of Popload).
